name: GhostCheckbox
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostCheckbox. Same behavioral props plus size and tone. Importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes styles to this instance. Hand-written until GHO-13 generates manifests.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: Controlled checked state, forwarded to the unstyled GhostCheckbox.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial checked state when modelValue is omitted, forwarded to the unstyled GhostCheckbox.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state, forwarded to the unstyled GhostCheckbox.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Forwards native disabled semantics to the unstyled GhostCheckbox.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size. The default omits data-size so CSS can treat a missing hook as md.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color intent. The default omits data-tone.

models.description: Checked state. Forwards update:modelValue from the unstyled GhostCheckbox.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The native checkbox after mount; null before mount and after unmount. Delegates to the unstyled GhostCheckbox.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the native checkbox when it is mounted and enabled. Delegates to the unstyled GhostCheckbox.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the native checkbox when it is mounted. Delegates to the unstyled GhostCheckbox.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The native checkbox input inside the display:contents themed scope.

states.name: checked
states.description: Checked and not mixed. Fills the box and draws a checkmark.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: Mixed visual state. Fills the box and draws a dash. Wins over checked.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-surface-bg
cssProperties.description: Unchecked box fill and mix surface for hover.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-primary-bg
cssProperties.description: Checked and mixed fill for the accent tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-primary-fg
cssProperties.description: Checkmark and dash color on the accent tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-primary-border
cssProperties.description: Box border on the accent tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-neutral-bg
cssProperties.description: Checked and mixed fill for the neutral tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-neutral-fg
cssProperties.description: Checkmark and dash color on the neutral tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-neutral-border
cssProperties.description: Box border on the neutral tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-danger-bg
cssProperties.description: Checked and mixed fill for the danger tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-danger-fg
cssProperties.description: Checkmark and dash color on the danger tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-danger-border
cssProperties.description: Box border on the danger tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-disabled-bg
cssProperties.description: Unavailable box fill.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-disabled-fg
cssProperties.description: Unavailable checkmark and dash color.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-disabled-border
cssProperties.description: Unavailable box border.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-icon-size
cssProperties.description: Painted box size inside the hit target.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-label-family
cssProperties.description: Font for the checked glyph painted on ::before.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-label-weight
cssProperties.description: Weight for the checked glyph.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-radius-sm
cssProperties.description: Corner radius of the painted box. Smaller than action-radius so the 1.1em box stays square.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-spinner-width
cssProperties.description: Thickness of the mixed-state dash.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-action-duration
cssProperties.description: Duration of color transitions on the painted box.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-border-hairline-width
cssProperties.description: Box border thickness.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-state-layer-hover
cssProperties.description: Hover mix amount on the current tone.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-press-scale
cssProperties.description: Pressed scale. 1 under reduced motion.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-easing-standard
cssProperties.description: Easing for color transitions.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-motion-duration-instant
cssProperties.description: Reduced-motion color transition duration.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-color
cssProperties.description: Outer color of the two-color keyboard focus indicator.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-contrast
cssProperties.description: Inner color of the two-color keyboard focus indicator.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-offset
cssProperties.description: Gap between the painted box and the focus ring.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-focus-ring-width
cssProperties.description: Thickness of the focus outline.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-sm-min
cssProperties.description: Hit target size for size sm.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-md-min
cssProperties.description: Hit target size for size md.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-control-size-lg-min
cssProperties.description: Hit target size for size lg.

keyboard.Space: Toggle checked when the control is enabled. Follows native mixed activation.
keyboard.Enter: Does not toggle. In a form, submits.
